fn:contentType.cost: O(path length); looks at the last extension only, compared without case.
fn:contentType.failure: none; a missing or unknown extension gives application/octet-stream.

fn:safeJoin.cost: O(path length); rejects "..", ".", empty segments, a leading slash, backslashes, colons and control characters.
fn:safeJoin.failure: WebError/Path (the relative path is empty, too long, absolute or has a segment that could escape the root).

fn:etag.cost: one SHA-256 over the body (native work, 4 units per input byte); the first 32 hex characters of the digest, quoted.
fn:etag.failure: WebError/Limit (the body is over the sha256 input limit of 1 MiB).

fn:notModified.cost: O(header length); true when If-None-Match is "*" or lists the current tag. Weak and strong forms compare equal.
fn:notModified.failure: none; an empty current tag or a malformed list gives false.

fn:parseRange.cost: O(header length); accepts one "bytes=a-b", "bytes=a-" or "bytes=-n" range and clips it to size.
fn:parseRange.failure: WebError/Syntax (not a single bytes range, or a bad number) and Unsatisfiable (size below 1, or the start is past the end).

fn:securityHeaders.cost: O(1); six fixed headers: nosniff, no framing, no referrer, a restrictive CSP, HSTS and no caching of responses by default.

fn:sessionCookie.cost: O(value length); Set-Cookie with Path=/, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, the given Max-Age and the Secure flag.
fn:sessionCookie.failure: WebError/Cookie (the name or token is not a valid cookie, or maxAge is below 1).

fn:clearSessionCookie.cost: O(name length); Set-Cookie with an empty value and Max-Age=0, with the same Path, HttpOnly and SameSite as sessionCookie.
fn:clearSessionCookie.failure: WebError/Cookie (the name is not a valid cookie name).

fn:readSession.cost: O(header length); reads the first Cookie header and returns the value of the named cookie.
fn:readSession.failure: none; a missing or malformed Cookie header, or no such cookie, gives None.

fn:parseForm.cost: O(body length); parses an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body with url.parseQuery (plus is a space).
fn:parseForm.failure: WebError/Form (malformed percent-encoding, or a body over the url.parseQuery limit).

fn:formValue.cost: O(fields); the value of the first field with that name. A field without = gives None.
fn:formValue.failure: none; a missing name gives None.

fn:redirectLocation.cost: O(target length); accepts only a path on the same origin: one leading slash, no backslash, no control characters.
fn:redirectLocation.failure: WebError/Redirect (a scheme, a host, a leading // or /\, a backslash, a control character, or a target over 2048 bytes).
